CustomField.label: Log Changes
CustomField.description: Keeps an audit trail for this grid. Every field change, and every record created, deleted or used in an action, is recorded in Grid Edit Log with the user and time. If a change cannot be logged, it is not made. Users need the Rowhouse Grid User permission set to write to the log.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select to record every change made in this grid in Grid Edit Log. Users need the Rowhouse Grid User permission set.
